2116153242174288356.en_summary: EliteOptionsTrader outlines a trade plan after massive gap down following $AMZN $INTC $SNDK earnings. October historically bearish in midterm years. Midterm elections next Tuesday. $SPX to 7500 in play if fails to hold 7600 support, $QQQ to 685 if cannot reclaim 700 by Monday. Tech and chips crushed: $AMD down 54 points, $DELL down 58, $SNDK down 123, MU down 59. Advises waiting until after midterms to start buying and not gambling on 0dte. Crypto down after $6B stolen from Binance.
